svg.title: Category save results
svg.desc: The API checks administrator access and input before writing. Valid changes and history commit together. The page refreshes only after confirmation and reports uncertainty when the committed response is lost.

g.data-value: Category and history commits, including failures and lost responses.
g.text: Category and history commits, including failures and lost responses.
